payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each character, iterate all substrings, use prefix sums to count matches, compute changes needed, store max length for each exact change count, then prefix max for queries.
payload.rationale: The solution systematically checks all intervals (l,r) per character, which is complete search over substrings. Since a subtype for 'complete_search' is missing, 'dp_interval' is the closest match because it operates on intervals, even though it does not use DP.
